referenceTransformationContract.failureAction: reject and regenerate from the authorized reference; do not repair a mutated product with copy

rules.statement: Describe the subject, room function, composition, material palette, camera intent, light direction, text-safe region, and exclusions explicitly; never rely on a bare style adjective.
Do not synthesize typography, prices, offers, labels, or logos inside generated imagery; add verified identity and copy as separate controlled layers.
Only provide reference images to a generation system when their media rights record explicitly permits model upload.
A generated scene containing a real product must be checked against authorized references and rejected for altered geometry, finish, scale, hardware, or countable details.

For a cinematic product-highlight shot, generate one optically unified product-and-environment keyframe from an authorized product reference. Do not default to placing a product cutout over a separately generated room.
Record at least one product-specific ratio, countable structural feature, or other objective invariant when the reference supports it, and reject a generated keyframe that fails the check.

promptStructure: Create a design-editorial {roomPurpose} that feels collected and livable.
Anchor the scene with {heroFurnishing}; support it with {materials} in {palette}.
Frame a natural wide room view with controlled verticals and believable scale.
Use soft directional daylight from {lightDirection}, restrained warm practicals, and tactile surface detail.
Keep {copySide} calm and low-detail for a separate copy layer.
Exclude {negativeIntent}. No words, labels, or logos.
composition.cameraIntent: Natural wide perspective at believable eye level; no stretched edges.

promptStructure: Depict the supplied product exactly as referenced, preserving silhouette, proportions, finish, materials, seams, hardware, and countable details.
Use a centered {angle} catalog view on white or very light neutral gray.
Light with a large soft source and restrained contact shadow; preserve honest color and texture.
No props, text, logo, invented variants, altered scale, or cropped edges.
composition.cameraIntent: Normal perspective matching the reference; whole product in frame.

inputSlots.reference: One or more authorized images that jointly resolve the full product.

promptStructure: Use the supplied product reference as the non-negotiable identity source. Preserve the product exactly; do not redesign, restyle, simplify, add, remove, or substitute any part.
Place the unchanged product as the primary anchor in {environment} at {timeOfDay} under {weather} conditions.
Build a layered but edited setting using {supportingMaterials}, with believable architecture and {scaleCues}.
Frame with {camera} and {framing}; match light direction, contact shadow, reflections, perspective, and real scale across product and environment.
Reserve {copySide} as quiet negative space and compose for {aspectRatio}.
No fake brand marks, text, changed product details, fashion posing, generic hotel styling, or duplicated product.
composition.failureAction: Reject on any product mismatch and regenerate from the original authorized input.

inputSlots.reference: Choose one authorized image per shot that most clearly resolves the depicted feature or whole-product proportion.

promptStructure: Use the supplied product reference as the non-negotiable identity source for one cinematic {storyFunction} keyframe.
Create one unified product-and-environment photograph; integrate perspective, scale, support contact, shadow, reflection, and {lightingIntent} optically across the full scene.
Preserve {productSpecificInvariants} exactly and do not reveal or invent components that the authorized reference does not support.
Frame with {camera}, reserve {copySide} as calm negative space, and compose for {aspectRatio}.
The result is a clean visual plate: no words, logo, price, offer, UI, callout, or synthetic label.
Reject product cutout compositing, altered geometry, changed material or finish, duplicated parts, generic hotel styling, and impossible contact or lighting.
qualityChecks: reference and keyframe compared side by side
product-specific ratio or countable feature passes
materials, finish, hardware, seams, and contact match
product and room feel optically unified
composition.failureAction: Reject the complete keyframe and regenerate from the authorized reference before any image-to-video work.

promptStructure: Create a collected, livable {roomPurpose}; the room, furnishings, and material story remain the primary subject.
Include one adult performing {personAction} in {personPlacement}, occupying less than one quarter of the frame.
Use natural posture and {wardrobeDirection}; the person is candid, not looking at camera, and secondary to the room.
Use {camera}, soft directional light at {timeOfDay}, and keep {copySide} calm for copy.
No fashion pose, direct gaze, exaggerated gesture, crowd, fake text, or logo.
Create a close material study of {craftDetail} from the supplied reference.
Use soft raking light from {lightDirection} to reveal weave, grain, glaze, patina, joinery, or hardware.
Keep the focal detail crisp with restrained falloff and natural color.
No wet-look gloss, fake dust, exaggerated blur, text, or invented construction.

evaluation.question: Does the result express collected, personal, material-rich living rather than generic premium interiors?
Are perspective, light, shadow, reflection, contact, architecture, and scale coherent?
Were all reference uploads authorized and all generated logos, words, product mutations, and unsupported claims excluded?
Does the output provide the intended crop, negative space, focal hierarchy, and resolution for its downstream composition?
